# NonHermitianTopology

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Topological properties arising from non-Hermitian Hamiltonians or matrices, where the non-Hermiticity leads to unique edge states and spectral phenomena absent in Hermitian systems. Extends topological computing to open systems with gain/loss, enabling new paradigms for information routing and fault-tolerant computation.
